correctness.rationale: The exact partial-transpose spectra of the displayed W-vacuum family yield both pairwise negativities and the pure A|BC negativity. The dimensionless reduction G=r/(r+k)[sqrt(t^2+4(1-t)k)+sqrt((1-t)^2+4tk)-1-2sqrt(k)] proves its threshold at k=1 and all zero boundaries. For k>1 the t-function is strictly concave, uniquely maximal at t=1/2. F(k)<0 for k>=1 makes (r+k)F'(k)-F(k) strictly decreasing through zero exactly once. Upper and lower asymptotic bounds coincide at sqrt(2)-1 for M_D/sqrt(D-1). Independent direct density-matrix partial-transpose eigenspectra agree at D=2,3,4. No finite calculation substitutes for the uniform analytic result.
